Build a Note Splitter in Python

This walkthrough splits a long page into notes, one function per step.

Last updated: March 2026. The steps work with any recent Python 3 release.

Section titled “1. The Steps”

The pipeline has three steps:

Split Sections
Render Notes
Idle

Each step takes the previous step's output.
